description.value: BK Market is a greengrocer on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood, stocking fresh fruits and vegetables. The shop sits on a busy arterial road that connects several residential and commercial areas, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through east Vancouver. As a produce-focused shop, it offers cyclists an opportunity to restock on fresh food mid-route.
